In the foreground, a woman with feline facial features and a man are positioned in front of the equipment, both with a sheen on their skin. The shot slowly pulls back, gradually revealing more of the subjects and the surrounding metallic apparatus.**

Please note that the video features **salient human subjects**, so you should focus on describing the spatial framing and movements of them.
